summary: The task involved updating an HWPX renewal playbook document with specific field replacements. The agent succeeded by extracting the ZIP archive, manually editing XML section files, removing linesegarray elements from modified paragraphs, and repackaging. Key insights: (1) This was a direct value replacement task without {{placeholders}} - the agent had to locate old values and replace them directly, (2) The document had static content that needed preservation alongside dynamic updates, (3) The agent correctly identified that linesegarray removal is paragraph-specific when doing manual edits. The existing hwpx-editing skill covers placeholder-based workflows well, but this trace reveals a variant: direct value replacement in non-templated documents. I'll add a reference document covering this pattern and update SKILL.md with guidance on when to use direct replacement vs placeholder-based approaches.
